cases.semantics: @ inside a pseudo argument is not a Legado chain delimiter
@ inside a quoted attribute value is not a Legado chain delimiter
@ inside a Jsoup regex pseudo argument is not a Legado chain delimiter

selectionPath: getStringListByCSS -> getElementsByCSSWithBridge -> large-document getElementsByCSSChain -> top-level @ chain split
failureCondition: The large-document fallback uses selector.split('@') and splits @ inside pseudo arguments or quoted attribute values. Pinned Legado uses the final @ only for the output attribute and keeps nested @ characters inside the CSS selector passed to Jsoup.
